componentTieBreak: First row-major seed: topmost, then leftmost pixel; ties retain first component

displayPoints.coordinateSpace: Primary-display local points, top-left origin for source mapping; canvas converts to AppKit bottom-left
displayPoints.mappingAssumption: Input is an uncropped full-primary-display capture; equal dimensions alone do not prove provenance

limit: Existing raster alpha diagnostic only. Capture provenance, shadows, tooltips, stale frames and occlusion require validation. Largest-component segmentation can omit detached icons, badges or menus and is not a product geometry rule. No live geometry route or product support edge established.
